tools.name: jumuncheck_get_country_rules
tools.description: How a restaurant bill works in each country JumunCheck covers: currency, sales tax and whether menu prices include it, service charge, cover charge, tipping custom, whether tap water is free, the legal drinking age, portion conventions, and short tips for first-time visitors.

tools.name: jumuncheck_get_guide
tools.description: A short dining guide for one country: what surprises first-time visitors, table etiquette, how ordering and paying work, useful phrases (English, local script and romanization), the main cities covered, and ids of dishes worth trying (see jumuncheck_list_dishes).

tools.name: jumuncheck_list_dishes
tools.description: JumunCheck's dish dictionary for one country: name in the requested language and locally, a short description, main ingredients, cooking method, taste levels (0–3), common allergens, diet flags, risk flags (raw, offal, alcohol, bones, shared plates) and the usual minimum number of people. tools.name: jumuncheck_list_places
tools.description: A small hand-picked list of restaurants JumunCheck knows in one country (optionally one city): name, local name, area, cuisine, tags such as english_menu, price level, a typical price per person, address and a map link. Details can be out of date — check before visiting.

tools.name: freshcheck_list_produce
tools.description: Nutrition profiles for common fruit and vegetables FreshCheck knows: calories, carbohydrate, protein, fat, fibre, sugars, vitamin C, potassium, vitamin A, folate and calcium per 100 g (USDA FoodData Central), a short plain-language summary and serving ideas. General information, not dietary advice.

tools.name: freshcheck_list_articles
tools.description: Short articles from FreshCheck on choosing produce, reading labels and expiry dates, simple recipes and basic nutrition: slug, title, topic (pillar), a one-line excerpt and tags. Read one with freshcheck_get_article.

tools.name: freshcheck_get_article
tools.description: The full text of one FreshCheck article (paragraphs or markdown), with practical tips and its source note. Get slugs from freshcheck_list_articles.

tools.name: nodajifi_list_common_sense
tools.description: NodajiFi's "good to know" cards: short practical and cultural facts (for example how to read laundry symbols) with a title, a few sentences and a category.

tools.name: nodajifi_list_quotes
tools.description: Short sayings NodajiFi shows learners, with the author as recorded ("Unknown" when there is none) and a category code.

tools.name: nodajifi_list_news
tools.description: Recent dated notes NodajiFi writes for learners about events and announcements (title, one-line summary, short text, type and date), newest first. They are learning material, not a live news feed.

tools.name: billygo_list_patterns
tools.description: BillyGo's carom billiards practice patterns: id, title, a one-line subtitle, category (for example basic or applied) and difficulty. Read the goal, the idea behind it and a coaching tip with billygo_get_pattern.

tools.name: billygo_get_pattern
tools.description: One BillyGo practice pattern: what to aim for, the idea behind it and a coaching tip. Get ids from billygo_list_patterns.

tools.name: migram_list_notes
tools.description: Short makeup and skin-care notes from migram (for example how to patch-test a new product): slug, title, topic (pillar), excerpt and tags. Read one with migram_get_note.

tools.name: migram_get_note
tools.description: The full text of one migram beauty note (paragraphs or markdown), with practical tips. Get slugs from migram_list_notes.

tools.name: migram_list_trends
tools.description: The makeup trends migram is featuring now: title, a one-line tagline, a short description of the look and a label such as "this month".

tools.name: iutgotgan_list_categories
tools.description: The five kinds of listing in IutGotGan, the neighbourhood trading app: producer sales, direct trade, swap and barter, garage sales, and free giveaways.
